gu.upToDateBody: NoCapOS {version} and the system packages are all caught up.
gu.sumRepair: The system packages need a fix-up
gu.bodySec: Security patches inside, don't sleep on them.
gu.bodyKernel: Kernel update inside, so restart the machine after.
gu.askMsg: Installing {what} in one go. Your settings, apps and files stay put.
gu.askRestartNoc: NoCapOS restarts itself at the end (the machine keeps running).
gu.runningBody: Takes a few minutes. Keep doing your thing while the system packages install.
gu.doneFail: The glow up hit a snag
gu.restartNeeded: Restart the machine to finish the glow up (fresh kernel installed).
gi.askBody: The new system ({size}) downloads and gets set up right next to the one you're on. Keep doing your thing; restart when it's ready. Files, apps and settings stay put.
gi.restartBody: The machine restarts into the new system. If anything's off, it jumps back to this one by itself.
gi.restartingBody: NoCapOS is back in a minute or two. This page reconnects on its own.
gi.installingBody: Only downloading what changed and writing it next to the running system. Keep vibing meanwhile.
gi.readyBody: Restart to finish. If the new system acts up, the machine goes back to this one by itself. No cap.
gi.checkingNewBody: NoCapOS just restarted into the update and is making sure it all works before keeping it.
gi.secBody: Fixes from Debian for {n} package(s) in the system. Don't sleep on them.
gi.availableBody: The whole system updates in one piece, so it can't get stuck halfway.
gi.failed: Couldn't prep the update to {version}. Nothing changed.
gi.updated: You're on NoCapOS {version} now. It all checks out.
gi.rolledBack: The update to {version} got undone: NoCapOS went back to {current}. Nothing's lost.
gi.reasonNoc: NoCapOS didn't start on the new system.
gi.reasonDesk: The screen's sign-in didn't come up on the new system.
gi.reasonBoot: The new system didn't finish starting.
gi.reasonCommit: The new system couldn't be made the default.
gi.channelHint: Beta gets new drops earlier, before everyone else.
gi.autoSecHint: Security patches install by themselves around {time} and the machine restarts. New versions still wait for you.
gi.aboutImage: NoCapOS {version} · system packages from Debian as of {snapshot}. The system is read-only and updates as a whole.
gu.runningApps: Updating apps ({done} of {n}). Their data and settings stay put.
